skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方指定单体造成量子属性伤害。
对我方全体造成量子属性伤害。
开启<u>连麦PK</u>，选择一名我方角色前往副战场战斗，其余角色留在主战场提供支援。<u>连麦PK</u>持续期间，欢愉技始终只能对副战场的敌方目标发动攻击。行动序列上出现连麦PK倒计时。\n连麦PK倒计时结束、处于副战场的我方角色陷入无法战斗状态、处于副战场的所有敌方目标被消灭、副战场没有可以战斗的我方角色，以上任意条件触发时，<u>连麦PK</u>解除。

501401001.desc: 我方全体目标将分别在<color=#f29e38ff>主战场和副战场</color>进行作战。在阿哈时刻以外，不同战场的我方和敌方目标<color=#f29e38ff>无法攻击</color>到另一战场的目标。在阿哈时刻期间，欢愉技始终只能对<color=#f29e38ff>副战场</color>的敌方目标发动攻击。\n连麦PK倒计时结束、处于副战场的我方角色陷入无法战斗状态、处于副战场的所有敌方目标被消灭、副战场没有可以战斗的我方角色，以上任意条件触发时，连麦PK解除。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使处于副战场的敌方目标获得【观众涌入】状态，其行动提前，并使其暴击率提高。
<u>连麦PK</u>解除时，若处于副战场的敌方目标全部被消灭，则使敌方全体受到的伤害提高，行动延后，恢复战技点，并使<u>阿哈</u>立即获得1个固定计入<u>笑点</u>的<u>额外回合</u>，该回合不消耗<u>笑点</u>。若<u>连麦PK</u>解除时，处于副战场的敌方目标未被全部消灭，则对前往副战场的我方角色造成大量量子属性伤害，并使其陷入【纠缠】状态。

10000000.name: 额外回合
10000000.desc: 获得1个不消耗回合数的额外回合，在此回合中无法插入施放终结技。

10000026.name: 阿哈
10000026.desc: 行动时，发动阿哈时刻，并使可施放欢愉技的单位各自施放1次欢愉技。若阿哈行动时不存在可施放欢愉技的单位，则阿哈施放【要有笑声】。\n阿哈时刻持续至本次最后一个欢愉技施放结束。\n阿哈时刻结束时，使参演的角色获得本次计入笑点的【好活当赏】状态，持续2回合。阿哈行动后会消耗全部笑点。

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target.
Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

Initiates <u>Live Showdown</u> and selects one target character to fight in sub-field while other characters remain in the prime-field providing support. During <u>Live Showdown</u>, Elation Skills can only target sub-field friendly units. A Live Showdown countdown appears in the Action Order.\nThe <u>Live Showdown</u> will be dispelled when any of these conditions are met: countdown ends, the sub-field target character is downed, all sub-field friendly units are defeated, or when there are no sub-field target characters left available to battle.

501401001.name: Live Showdown
501401001.desc: All ally targets will engage in combat in <color=#f29e38ff>prime-field and sub-field</color> respectively. Aside the Aha Instant, targets from different battlefields <color=#f29e38ff>cannot attack</color> targets on the other battlefield. During the Aha Instant, Elation Skills can only be used to attack enemy targets that are <color=#f29e38ff>on the sub-field</color>.\nLive Showdown will be dispelled when any of these conditions are met: Live Showdown countdown ends, an sub-field ally character is knocked down, all sub-field enemy targets are defeated, or there are no sub-field ally characters remaining who can battle.

skill_list.skill_desc: Apply the "Flooding Viewers" state to sub-field friendly units, advancing their actions and increasing their CRIT Rate.

If all sub-field friendly units are defeated when <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, increases the DMG taken by all friendly units, delays their actions, recovers Skill Points, and enables <u>Aha</u> to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u> where a fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> is taken into account. This extra turn does not consume <u>Punchline</u>. If not all sub-field friendly units are defeated when <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, then deals massive Quantum DMG to target characters going into the sub-field, and inflicts them with "Entanglement."

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000026.name: Aha
10000026.desc: When taking action, triggers an Aha Instant and causes units capable of using Elation Skills to each use their Elation Skill 1 time. If there are no units capable of using Elation Skills when Aha takes action, Aha will use "Let There Be Laughter."\nThe Aha Instant lasts until the final Elation Skill finishes this time.\nWhen the Aha Instant ends, participating characters gain the "Certified Banger" state for the Punchline points taken into account this time, lasting for 2 turns. After Aha takes action, all Punchlines will be consumed.
